Name: [System] antenna_patterns — Antenna Patterns tab visible on launch
Objective: Verify the Antenna Patterns tab is present and accessible in the main window.
Precondition: Application installed and Python environment ready.
Test Script (Step): Launch the Calibration Statistics Tool application (python main.py).
Test Script (Expected Result): Main window opens without crash.

Test Script (Step): Locate the tab bar at the top of the main window.
Test Script (Expected Result): A tab labelled "Antenna Patterns" is visible in the tab bar.

Test Script (Step): Click the "Antenna Patterns" tab.
Test Script (Expected Result): The Antenna Patterns tab becomes the active view. The tab content is rendered with no errors or blank panels.

Name: [System] antenna_patterns — Start with no parsed PTU2 data
Objective: Verify the evaluation handles an empty parsed-data list gracefully without a crash.
Precondition: Application launched. No PTU2 files have been parsed (the parsed-data list is empty).
Test Script (Step): Open the Antenna Patterns tab.
Test Script (Expected Result): Antenna Patterns tab is visible.

Test Script (Step): Click the Start button.
Test Script (Expected Result): Application does not crash. An error message is logged: ""No parsed PTU-2 files found!"" or similar. No output files are written to the output folder. The GUI remains responsive.

Name: [System] antenna_patterns — Successful evaluation with valid PTU2 data
Objective: Verify that clicking Start with a valid parsed-data set produces PNG plots and a YAML/JSON output file.
Precondition: Application launched. At least one PTU2 file has been parsed successfully via the Parse Protocols tab.
Test Script (Step): Open the Antenna Patterns tab. Confirm default settings (Tables 0–3 enabled, Target Angle, Normal, Chirp 0, yaml v1).
Test Script (Expected Result): Tab shows default configuration.

Test Script (Step): Click the Start button.
Test Script (Expected Result): Evaluation starts. Log panel shows ""Starting."" and ""Loading data."" messages.

Test Script (Step): Wait for the evaluation to finish.
Test Script (Expected Result): Log shows "Image generated: …" for each table that found data. No Python exception or crash.

Test Script (Step): Open the output/ folder (antenna_patterns sub-directory if separate).
Test Script (Expected Result): At least one .png plot file exists per enabled table that had matching data. At least one .yaml output file exists.

Test Script (Step): Open a generated .yaml file in a text editor.
Test Script (Expected Result): The YAML contains ""type: antennaPattern""
Labels: ""data:"" section with ""patterns:"" list. Each pattern entry includes patternType

Name: [System] antenna_patterns — Target Angle vs PTU Angle selection
Objective: Verify that switching between Target Angle and PTU Angle changes the angle axis of the output.
Precondition: Application launched and PTU2 data is available (parsed). Default Antenna Patterns tab settings.
Test Script (Step): Open the Antenna Patterns tab. Select ""Target Angle"" radio button in Input Configuration.
Test Script (Expected Result): Target Angle"" radio is selected.

Test Script (Step): Click Start and wait for evaluation.
Test Script (Expected Result): PNG plots are generated. X-axis label in the plot file reads ""Target Angle [°]"".

Test Script (Step): Select the ""PTU Angle"" radio button.
Test Script (Expected Result): PTU Angle"" radio is now selected. ""Target Angle"" radio is deselected.

Test Script (Step): Click Start again.
Test Script (Expected Result): New PNG plots are generated. X-axis label reads ""PTU Angle [°]"".

Test Script (Expected Result): Upside-Down"" radio button is now checked.

Name: [System] antenna_patterns — Chirp selection
Objective: Verify that enabling additional chirps results in additional output files.
Precondition: Application launched and PTU2 data containing multiple active chirps is available.
Test Script (Step): Open the Antenna Patterns tab. Ensure only Chirp 0 is checked.
Test Script (Expected Result): Only Chirp 0 checked. Chirps 1–3 are unchecked.

Test Script (Step): Click Start and count the generated output files.
Test Script (Expected Result): Output files are generated for Chirp 0 only.

Test Script (Step): Check the ""Chirp 1"" check box.
Test Script (Expected Result): Chirp 1 is now checked.

Test Script (Step): Click Start again (ensure PTU2 data with Chirp 1 active exists).
Test Script (Expected Result): Additional output files are generated corresponding to Chirp 1 (file names include ""Chirp1""). No crash.

Test Script (Step): Uncheck all chirp check boxes.
Test Script (Expected Result): All chirps are unchecked.

Test Script (Step): Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Evaluation completes without crash. No output is generated or log reports ""Invalid chirp configuration.""

Name: [System] antenna_patterns — Table enable/disable toggles
Objective: Verify that only checked tables are included in the evaluation and output.
Precondition: Application launched and PTU2 data is available.
Test Script (Step): Open the Antenna Patterns tab. Uncheck Tables 1–3 so only Table 0 is enabled.
Test Script (Expected Result): Only Table 0 check box is ticked.

Test Script (Step): Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Evaluation completes. Output contains data for Table 0 only. Log shows exactly one ""Table lookup scheduled"" entry for Table 0 (per chirp/angle combo).

Test Script (Step): Re-enable Table 1 (check its check box) and Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Output now includes data for Tables 0 and 1. Log shows two ""Table lookup scheduled"" entries.

Test Script (Step): Uncheck all tables and click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Log reports no tables scheduled. No YAML/JSON output file is produced. No crash.
